item.title: ⚜️ What the hell are you waiting for ? Free sessions. Free lunch. Porto.
item.author: stationsolutions@gmail.com (rodrigo pinto)
item.description: Another CollabDays Portugal is coming… and this time we’re going back to Porto, 16 October 2026, at ANJE. I’ve been involved in community events for quite a few years now and there is still something about this model that makes me stop and think… Where else can you simply register, show up in the morning and spend an entire day listening to people who normally speak at some of the biggest Microsoft conferences around the world… talking about Microsoft 365, Azure, AI, Copilot, Power Platform, security, agents and whatever new thing Microsoft decided to release three days before the event 😁 … and pay absolutely nothing for it?
